text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (――The world is full of sound.)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(The gentle breeze... the rustling 
trees... the chirping birds... the breath 
of life...)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(They all blend into a harmonious 
ensemble, creating beautiful music...!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(This session between the world and me 
stirs my soul more vividly than words, 
more vividly than light...!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(Indeed, music always stirs deep 
emotion...! And the finest of all is—)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(—A harmony where the Umamusume strum the 
sounds of their souls through their 
running, clashing their rhythms together!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (Which means... a race...!!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ah...! Joy is overflowing from within...!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(At last, it begins...! My journey in 
search of the ultimate sessionâ)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(My challenge for the Twinkle Series 
is—!!)

—Our three-year journey taking on the 
Twinkle Series together with Sounds of 
Earth was finally about to begin.

Today being the first day, I got up early 
full of motivation and headed towards the 
Trainer's Office. On the way there—

With a newly bought dictionary of musical 
terms in hand, I was studying.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer. Is it all right if we start off 
at moderato?"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Also, I want to change the mezzo-forte in 
this fourth bar to fortissimo. It'll 
resonate much better that way, don't you 
think?"

...Sounds of Earth frequently quotes 
musical terms in almost every sentence.

"In order to facilitate smooth 
communication for our days ahead together, 
I am studying during my spare time—"

I hope I can put this to use when talking 
to her later today. Just as I was thinking 
that—

Faint, yet unmistakable. Somewhere in the 
academy, the sound of a violin was 
echoing.

Following the sound to the academy's 
track, I found Sounds of Earth there, just 
as expected.

Once the performance begins, one cannot 
help but stop and listen intently.

"That melody has always had a powerful 
force that speaks far deeper than words 
ever could. What I feel in my heart right 
now is—"
...Passion, and jubilation.

Her heart is blazing with passion. 
Surely... just like mine—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my dearest direttore! You startled 
me—how long have you been there?
choice_data_list:
I heard your performance, just a little 
while ago...

I heard your performance a little while 
ago...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my dearest direttrice! You startled 
me—how long have you been there?
choice_data_list:
I heard your performance, just a little 
while ago...

I heard your performance a little while 
ago...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
My goodness...! So you held your breath 
and waited all that time just for my 
performance to finish?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Grazie...! Fufu, how fateful...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
After all, what I was just playing was 
born from thoughts of our future together.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
To think that you would appear, led by 
that—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Benisssimo!! A truly fitting start for the 
day it all begins!!!
choice_data_list: Yeah. It's deeply... commozione, isn't it?

text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly, it was a word 
with the nuance of 'deeply moved'... I'm 
not sure if I'm using it right, but—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Molto bene!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe it, did you really take 
the time to learn that just for me? *Sono 
commossa*!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Just how much joy do you intend to bring 
me...! And to think this is merely the 
prelude—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Indeed. This is merely... the prelude...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Prestissimo is a bad habit of mine. If I 
get this worked up already, my heart won't 
be able to handle it...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Because we're going to create the 
greatest jam session in the future!"

"—The 'supreme session' she speaks of. 
That is the very reason the Umamusume 
Sounds of Earth runs, and her ultimate 
goal."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, what I desire is— the ultimate 
session!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"The finest Umamusume, the finest 
environment, the finest race... and beyond 
that, a grandioso session!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "That is the very reason I run!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "...You understood that."

—On that day, I played with all my heart 
for her sake.

I want to see the moment Sounds of Earth 
performs her greatest session, her finest 
melody. That is why I want to walk 
alongside her.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...*Brillante*. Your eyes hold a radiant 
sparkle."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
So... what do you think? Shall we play an 
animato duo together under the morning 
glow?

She's probably proposing we "keep training 
just like this." I can't just brush off 
her heightened enthusiasm...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Sì! Let us make armonia resonate together!

And so, I ended up training with Sounds of 
Earth from early morning, and—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Doing this really is different from 
training all by oneself...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
That was truly a giocoso piece of 
musica...!

By the time I had finished checking all 
aspects of Sounds of Earth's current 
running form, the sun had risen 
completely.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
How was it, Trainer? Did you find 
esaltazione in my running?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Oops.

As I reached for a dictionary to look up 
the words Sounds of Earth had spoken, her 
hand gently rested over mine—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Even without looking into it, you ought 
to know.

Having that whispered so gently into my 
ear made my heart skip a beat. I hurriedly 
took a step back—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
That is what we call esaltazione, 
Direttore.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
That is what we call esaltazione, 
Direttrice.

—I was reminded of what excitement truly 
felt like.
choice_data_list: It certainly got my heart pounding...!

text_block_list.text:
"The truth is, seeing Sounds of Earth run 
today made me feel an indescribable 
fascination once again."

What kind of session will that running 
lead to? My expectations just keep 
soaring...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Benissimo! First and foremost, I must be 
able to thrill the person closest to 
me—you!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Keep your expectations high. For your 
passionate gaze will only sharpen my 
running even further!

Afterward, based on the first day of 
training, we held a meeting to review our 
future training policy—
choice_data_list:
—And with that, let's keep giving it our 
all tomorrow too!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Sì! It truly was a fulfilling first day!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Well then, now that we've reached a good 
stopping point.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I've got to write down these emotions...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: The sound!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The things born from the days spent with 
you. The resonance. This is how I preserve 
them.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Small sounds like these layer together to 
form a melody, eventually creating a 
magnificent piece of music—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Do you understand? This is a piece of 
music we are composing, for our own sake. 
Just a fragment of it.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The melody that crowns the climax lies 
within the supreme session that we shall 
create!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"With that, this song is finally 
complete...!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Don't you find it thrilling? Direttore.
choice_data_list: I'm really looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Don't you find it thrilling? Direttrice.
choice_data_list: I'm really looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Bravissimo! —And that smile of yours is 
wonderful too.

And so, the curtain rose on the days of 
challenges alongside Sounds of Earth!!
